name: TrustMRR / DataFa.st
description: Marc Lou's revenue verification platform. DataFa.st reached $10K MRR. TrustMRR lets founders verify Stripe revenue publicly. Marc Lou built 27+ startups as a solo founder, total ~$2M revenue. His CodeFa.st (learn to code) and ShipFa.st (ship startups) are additional revenue streams.

name: 1Lookup
description: Phone/email/IP verification API for developers. Filters invalid/fraud info at registration and payment steps. TrustMRR Stripe verified at $241,801 MRR. Pricing: free 100 calls/mo → $29/mo 5,000 calls → $99/mo 50,000 calls → enterprise. Boring but essential — every signup form needs this.

name: Buildpad
description: AI co-founder that helps you build projects. SaaS just crossed $1,800 MRR (Reddit r/SideProject). Acts as an AI-powered product development companion for solo founders.

name: SuperX
description: Platform to grow faster on X (Twitter) the right way. Built by Rob Hallam and Tibo Louis-Lucas. Hit $23K MRR in 6 months after 5 previous product failures. Founder reverse-engineered viral X posts to build the growth platform.

name: Simple Analytics
description: Privacy-first web analytics, GDPR-compliant GA alternative. Built by two Dutch indie developers. MRR crossed $30,000. Launched Sept 2018, took 5+ years. Completely Build In Public — public dashboard shares all traffic, revenue, and satisfaction data.

name: Skeb
description: Illustration commission service built entirely solo by なるがみ (Yoshikazu Kita). Launched Nov 2018, sold July 2023 to 実業之日本社 for ~10億円 ($7M+). Monthly transaction volume peaked at 6億円. Founder was himself part of the illustration community — perfect 'scratch your own itch'.

name: Peing -質問箱-
description: Anonymous Q&A box. Built in just 6 hours by せせり. Went viral within 3 weeks — hitting 8M+ PV/day. Acquired by Jiraffe for estimated 数億円 ($2-5M). Proof that timing + simplicity + social virality can beat complex products.

name: ブックメーカー (Bookmaker)
description: Japanese indie-developed service, sold company for 17億円 (~$12M). Built almost entirely by 1 person. Service-based revenue model. One of Japan's biggest indie dev exits.

name: Inkdrop
description: Markdown note-taking app by TAKUYA (YouTube 'devaslife'). Monthly subscription model generating 月15万円+ ($1K+/mo) stable revenue. Desktop + mobile support, high quality, 1-person operation. Steady niche product over years.

name: 文字数カウントメモ
description: Real-time character count memo app by takashi. 累計70万DL突破, 累計700万円以上 ($50K+) in ad revenue. Ultra-simple: does one thing (count characters) for writers/students. 100+ apps released — this one was the hit. 'Quantity leads to quality' strategy.

name: Footyamigo
description: Profitable football data SaaS. $41,930 ($53K) revenue in last 12 months, 69% profit margin, 223.9K/mo organic traffic. Subscription plans at £24.99/mo plus commission from strategy marketplace sales. UK-based solo founder.

name: Lead Scraping SaaS (Flippa listing)
description: High-margin SaaS with 43% profit, strong recurring revenue, 202 subscribers, multi-platform lead scraping tech. Listed for sale on Flippa. Vetted by Flippa team for accuracy.

name: HIX.AI / Pollo.ai
description: AI writing and video generation platform by 阿彪Bill. ARR千万美金级 ($10M+). Pollo.ai launched Oct 2024, hit 3M monthly visits in 4 months. Ranked #38 on a16z Top 100 AI products. Aggregates multiple AI video models (Kling, Hailuo, Pixverse, Luma, Veo2, Runway Gen-4).

name: Alitu
description: Podcast SaaS platform. 年收入百万级 (annual revenue ~$140K+). Built from podcasting experience. Pricing rose from $28→$32/mo with no drop in signups. Mentioned on V2EX as a podcast SaaS success story.

name: Nomad List / Remote OK
description: Pieter Levels (@levelsio) portfolio. Nomad List — city cost/safety data for digital nomads. Multiple services run in parallel. Annual revenue $3M+. Levelsio recently launched fly.pieter.com — went $0→$1M ARR in 17 days. Uses simple PHP+MySQL stack, builds in public.

name: Coconote
description: AI study tool. Hit $6.7M ARR in just 18 months. Built by Zack Hargett and Brett Bauman. Turns recorded lectures into notes, flashcards, and quizzes using AI. Massive student market.

name: LaserPecker
description: Consumer laser engraver by 深圳清闲智能 (ex-Huawei engineer founder). 全球众筹累计破3亿元, 年销售额近5亿元 ($70M+). Weight ~6kg, entry price ¥2,000. 65% self-developed parts. Sold in 50+ countries, in Walmart. DTC model: indie site + social media, 30% higher conversion than Amazon. 'Helps small businesses make money' positioning.

name: Friendly.is
description: Built close to $100K ARR without writing any code — just wrapping existing open-source projects into SaaS offerings. Uses open-source tools and packages them as paid services. Perfect example of 'open-source wrapper' monetization model.

name: Tag Parrot
description: Google indexing tool — helps websites get indexed faster via API submission. Hit $150K ARR in ~1 year. Targets non-technical website owners. SEO niche: submission to Google Search Console via API. Simple but high-demand problem for site owners.

name: Indexed Pro
description: Google indexing tool competitor. Reached $60K ARR in just 3+ months. Similar to Tag Parrot — submits URLs to search engines for faster indexing. Expanding to support Bing, Yahoo, Yandex for cross-engine coverage.

name: Kuli Kuli (菜单翻译App)
description: Menu translation app for travelers. Solves the specific pain point: all translation apps suck at restaurant menu translation. AI-powered understanding of menu items with cultural context. Niche but universal need for international travelers. Mentioned on 即刻 by 瓦恁.

name: テック・ブック・ランク (Tech Book Rank)
description: Tech book ranking service by ジャバ・ザ・ハットリ. Extracts tech book info from Qiita API, presents as rankings. Hit 10万円 in sales within 3 weeks of launch. Niche content curation + affiliate model.

name: Storemapper
description: Shopify app showing store locations on maps. Built solo by Tyler Tringas. Reached 7-figure annual revenue. Eventually sold. Tyler then founded Earnest Capital — micro-SaaS investment fund. Early Shopify ecosystem play paid off big.

name: Chrome Extensions (market overview)
description: 8 Chrome extensions by indie developers with impressive revenue: 1) ~$130K/mo extension (10K subscribers, 2019 data); 2) Closet Tools ~$42K/mo verified on IndieHackers; 3) Extension at $100K revenue (Aug 2020). Premium features at $1/mo. Extensions are viable solo-dev business — low maintenance, platform distribution.

name: 好事发生 App
description: Happiness/gratitude journal app by 王梦珂Mengke. Launched on App Store with themed updates (e.g., '多肉呱呱' theme). Free app building user base; author also wrote book '把才华变成钱' (Turn Talent into Money) about personal branding for indie creators. Content+product flywheel.
